description: The Security Kernel is a C++ implementation of cryptographic functions accessible by an object-oriented API. Depending on configuration, the algorithms may be implemented in software, hardware or both. The industry standard Cryptoki API from PKCS #11, is used as the interface to hardware-based cryptographic modules.
